description: Ability to review, validate, and improve metadata and documentation generated by automated/AI-driven processes, ensuring all outputs are standards-compliant, rich, and machine-actionable.
historic work: Key Activities: 'Prepares, edits, validates and disseminates statistical metadata, ensuring that it is correctly loaded to the corporate metadata repository.'
change to work: This activity will transform from direct manual preparation and editing to verification, oversight, and refinement of automatically generated (AI-driven) metadata. Officer will now focus on validation of correctness, completeness, and machine-readability/interoperability of outputs, collaborating on updates to automation rules and standards where needed.
justification: Officer must transition from hands-on metadata production to being able to understand, manage, and quality-assure AI/automation-generated metadata.

description: Understanding of modern metadata formats and standards (e.g., SDMX, fully structured XML/JSON), interoperability protocols, and metadata system integrations.
historic work: Key Activities: 'Prepares, edits, validates and disseminates statistical metadata, ensuring that it is correctly loaded to the corporate metadata repository.'
change to work: This activity will transform from direct manual preparation and editing to verification, oversight, and refinement of automatically generated (AI-driven) metadata. description: Ability to participate in or advise on the design, tuning, and iterative improvement of automated metadata workflow tools and processes.

Testing will increasingly mean checking effectiveness and accuracy of automation, not just new manual procedures.
